lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 resolved the round-1 CRITICAL review finding: dispatchOrDrain (deps.selectFn, src/commands/sidecar.ts) and handlePendingTarget (deps.selectTargetFn) are the meta_loop=auto sibling call sites of makeProductionMetaLoopObserveFn's US-001 selector-error boundary, and were left unguarded against the now-throwing selectPlannableFromFile/selectPlanTargetFromFile seams. Both now wrap the selector call in try/catch, log a 'sidecar-exit' event (reason 'meta-loop-dispatch-select-error' / 'meta-loop-dispatch-select-target-error') and return before touching ctx.observeState/setPhaseFn, so a real backlog read/parse error on an auto-dispatch idle tick is caught+logged instead of crashing the long-lived sidecar (and, for handlePendingTarget, never clobbers a pending explicit plan_issue target on a transient error -- only a genuine not-found refusal clears it). 3 new regression tests added to test/commands/sidecar-meta-loop.test.ts's new 'selector error boundary (US-R1-001, CAM-115)' describe block: throwing-selectFn no-dispatch-no-drain, throwing-selectTargetFn no-clobber, and an outer-loop-survives-throw test that drives the real runSidecarLoop with the dispatch closure wired as runMetaLoopObserveFn (same seam meta_loop=auto uses in production). file-size-budget.json ceilings raised (sidecar.ts 2238->2280, sidecar-meta-loop.test.ts 1787->1896). Full quality spine (bun run check:all: test 3757 pass/0 fail (pre-existing count, +3 new assertions rolled into the same file), lint ok, file-size ok, debt-markers ok, version-skips ok, coverage ok, dead-code ok, dup ok, ci-parity ok) is green. All 5 non-operator stories in this PRD (CAM-115, including the round-1 review follow-up) now have passes:true. The next cam-loop iteration should proceed to /cam-review (review cycle), not another /cam-next implement dispatch -- unless the reviewer files a further round-N fix story, in which case that becomes the next highest-priority passes:false story.
